name: DatePicker
description: To select or input a date.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Customize clear button

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.

props.name: dateRender
props.description: Custom rendering function for date cells, >= 5.4.0 use `cellRender` instead.

props.name: cellRender
props.type: (current: dayjs, info: { originNode: VueNode, today: DateType, range?: 'start' \| 'end', type: PanelMode, locale?: Locale, subType?: 'hour' \| 'minute' \| 'second' \| 'meridiem' }) => VueNode
props.description: Custom rendering function for picker cells

props.name: components
props.description: Custom panels. A custom panel component should set `inheritAttrs: false`; otherwise the picker-injected props (e.g. `prefixCls`) fall through to its root node, causing child components (such as Flex) to emit styles under the wrong prefix and break the panel layout

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state of picker

props.name: disabled
props.description: Determine whether the DatePicker is disabled

props.name: disabledDate
props.type: (currentDate: dayjs, info: { from?: dayjs, type: Picker }) => boolean
props.description: Specify the date that cannot be selected

props.name: format
props.description: To set the date format, support multi-format matching when it is an array, display the first one shall prevail. refer to [dayjs#format](https://day.js.org/docs/en/display/format). for example: [Custom Format](#date-picker-demo-format)
props.descriptionZh: 展示的日期格式，配置参考 [dayjs#format](https://day.js.org/docs/zh-CN/display/format#%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F%E5%8C%96%E5%8D%A0%E4%BD%8D%E7%AC%A6%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)。

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: Set the binding value format. After setting, `value`, `defaultValue`, and `v-model:value` can use formatted strings, and `change` returns strings in the same format. Demo: [Value Format](#date-picker-demo-value-format)

props.name: order
props.description: Auto order date when multiple or range selection

props.name: ~~popupClassName~~
props.description: To customize the className of the popup calendar, use `classes.popup.root` instead

props.name: preserveInvalidOnBlur
props.description: Not clean input on blur even when the typing is invalidate

props.name: getPopupContainer
props.description: To set the container of the floating layer, while the default is to create a `div` element in `body`

props.name: inputReadOnly
props.description: Set the `readonly` attribute of the input tag (avoids virtual keyboard on touch devices)

props.name: locale
props.description: Localization configuration

props.name: minDate
props.description: The minimum date, which also limits the range of panel switching

props.name: maxDate
props.description: The maximum date, which also limits the range of panel switching

props.name: mode
props.description: The picker panel mode（ [Cannot select year or month anymore?](/docs/vue/faq#when-set-mode-to-datepickerrangepicker-cannot-select-year-or-month-anymore) )

props.description: Need click confirm button to trigger value change. Default `false` when `multiple`

props.name: nextIcon
